title: MCP clients get a new authorization flow
summary:
MCP clients got OAuth 2.1, Grok-3 Mini joined the model list, and two community listings got attention.

MCP authentication moved from session polling to OAuth 2.1, with PKCE, client registration and refresh tokens. The same PR changed Azure GPT Image editing to fetch string image inputs as URLs; data URIs, local file paths and direct Buffer inputs are no longer accepted.

The `grok` listing now points to Azure-hosted Grok-3 Mini with tool support, while `openai-large` routes to GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-4.1 Mini. The auth UI also labels its settings “Referrer/Domain Management” and removes a misleading API-token notice.

The directory now lists AdvanceChatGptBot, a Telegram bot using Pollinations through gpt4free. Mirexa AI Chat’s listing gained a fuller description and corrected name, and its duplicate entry was removed.

highlights.title: OAuth for MCP clients
highlights.text: MCP clients can use OAuth 2.1 authorization with PKCE, client registration and refresh tokens instead of the old session-polling flow. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Grok-3 Mini with tools
highlights.text: The `grok` text model listing adds Azure-hosted Grok-3 Mini with tool support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok).

highlights.title: GPT-4.1 for openai-large
highlights.text: `openai-large` now routes to GPT-4.1 instead of GPT-4.1 Mini. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).
